book: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
title: The Witch’s Sledge
brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road and into Narnia. In Chapter 4, Edmund meets the White Witch on her sledge. Build the sledge stop, then take a photo for your teacher.
look: This stop is a snowy wood, from Chapter 4. The Witch makes a hot drink and Turkish Delight appear in the snow.

steps.title: Know your models
steps.text: These are your five models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the **Canvas** tab.

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Press the **top button on your right controller** and click **Models**. Put the **deer** in the snow. Put the **crown** up high beside it. Put the **bottle**, **cup** and **box** in the snow.

steps.title: Say it out loud
steps.frame: “The Witch was nice to Edmund because ___. He should not trust her because ___.”
steps.text: Point to the crown and say this out loud:
steps.spoken: Point to the crown and say this out loud. The Witch was nice to Edmund because… He should not trust her because…

steps.title: Snap and submit
steps.fits: the deer, the crown, the bottle, the cup and the box

extra.text: Add four **Snowballs**, one for each child the Witch asks about. Say why she wants all four.

points: Your photo shows the deer, the crown, the bottle, the cup and the box in the snow.

mapday.intro: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read each line from the book and tap who said it. Then finish two sentences about telling the truth.
mapday.miss: Not that one. Think about who talks like that in Chapters 4 and 5.
mapday.done: ✓ You found every speaker. Now finish the two sentences.

scene.aria: A snowy wood with a lamp-post and a spot for each person who talks

clues.q: “Next time! Next time! Don’t forget. Come soon.”
